name: Own-savings standing order with two other bills short on the same account (G426)

expected.notes: G426 (Kevin 2026-11-06). Today Mon 23 Nov 2026, payday Fri 27 Nov, window 23 to 26 Nov. Barclays Current holds 150 and carries an own-savings standing order of 300 into Barclays Saver on Tue 24 Nov, a Phone bill of 100 on Wed 25 Nov and a Gas bill of 200 on Thu 26 Nov (all on different days so the order of the walk is plain). Walk: 150 - 300 = -150, then -250 after Phone, then -450 after Gas. After payments and low point -450, verdict short. Payments alone, order left out: 150 - 100 - 200 = -150, so the payments are 150 short on their own. Savings part = 450 - 150 = 300 (amber). The payment part, 150, is the only payment shortfall (red stays earned). One combined move covers the whole walk deficit: ceil5(450) + 10 = 460. Monzo Current holds 500, headroom 490, so one move of 460 from Monzo to Barclays (the saver is never a source). Earmarks: Monzo set aside 460, Spend from 500 - 460 = 40; Barclays Spend from 10 (cushion). Short after cover = max(0, 450 - 460) = 0. Savings covered by the move = min(300, 460 - 150) = 300, so not no-cover. At risk count 1: in the payment-only walk 150 - 100 = +50 after Phone (it clears, so it only bounced because of the order) and 50 - 200 = -150 after Gas, so only Gas is a payment at risk; the order is a movement and never counts. Left to spend: pool 650 - 300 - 100 - 200 = 50 = 40 + 10. Payday plan null (G402). G438 (Kevin 2026-11-07), which supersedes the savings at risk reading above: the order is an ordinary predicted payment. Walk as before: -150 after the order (a movement, never counted), -250 after Phone (bounces, counts), -450 after Gas (bounces, counts). At risk count 2 (was 1: Phone is no longer discounted because it bounced only after the order). One cover move of 460 from Monzo, Spend from 40 and 10, Left to spend 50 are unchanged. The savings_at_risk facts are gone.
